verdict.rationale: The only scheduling evidence is indirect. The n8n integration claims you can "send, schedule, and track emails without writing code," which is a third-party, no-code route rather than the send API. The pricing page lists "Send time optimization," which is not developer-controlled scheduling. Missing for 10: documented API parameter for scheduling future delivery, API ability to cancel a scheduled message before it sends, first-party API docs on scheduling limits, hands-on or independent corroboration.
